# Lionheart Fixt 0.44.0 - the morning after

There's a man in the Port District tavern who is too drunk to speak. If you spare him a single gold
for another ale — for nothing, because he asked and you had it — he teaches you a style of fighting
he learned in the worst bars in Europe.

That's all in the original game, and it's one of the kindest small things in it.

Talk to him again and he says *"Good to see you again, friend. Grab an ale and enjoy yourself."*

And that's it. Forever. **That conversation has no replies in it at all.**

## Three people who couldn't reach each other

Quinn the herbalist, over in the Gate District, has always said this:

> *"Indeed, I can brew a concoction to cure many afflictions of the mind and body, given the right
> recipe and the proper ingredients. If you run across any such ailments, come to me, and we will
> see what can be done."*

**Nothing in the game can bring him one.** There's also a `Hangover Cure Potion` in the files that
nothing gives you, and an empty quest file called *Gather Nightshade Root for Quinn*.

Three open hands, no way to join them.

## Now

Come back to the tavern after Montserrat falls and he's honest with you:

> *"Friend, I have been drinking since the news came down from the abbey, and I have reached the part
> where the drinking stops helping. My head is a cathedral bell and somebody is still ringing it."*

Quinn can fix that. What he can't do is get nightshade root, which doesn't grow in Spain — but he
knows a woman in Montaillou the villagers go to when they won't go to a licensed man, and he'd
rather you didn't mention him.

She gives it to you for nothing:

> *"Take it. No, spiritbearer, no coin; a thing like this is given or it is nothing. But understand
> what you are carrying: in a thimble it quiets a man, and in a spoon it quiets him permanently."*

## What he gives you back

He drinks it in one go, which is not how it was meant to be taken, and then sits very still.

> *"...Oh. Oh, that is quiet. I had forgotten quiet. Friend, listen to me while I can still think in
> a straight line, because it will not last: I showed you how to fight when the room is moving. That
> is the easy half. The hard half is the morning, when it stops, and you see every single thing you
> walked past the night before and did not notice."*

And then he teaches you that too. **Clear Head** — +3 Find Traps and Secret Doors.

It's the only perk in this mod I've written from scratch rather than found, and I want to be straight
about that: the game has nine perks taught by people, and all nine were already reachable. This one
is mine. It's built exactly like his first one, down to the same guard that keeps it off your
level-up list, because it should feel like it came from the same man.

## Installing

Unzip and double-click **`Mod Manager.bat`**, then click the button that names the mod.

Works on **any save**, but the chain starts with buying him that ale, so if you never did, he's still
just a man speaking in tongues.

## If you play it

**The check that matters:** get as far as needing the root, then go to Montaillou and talk to the
weird woman. If her reply about nightshade isn't there, a gate is silently failing and the chain is
dead in the middle. That one nearly shipped broken and I'd like it confirmed.

**And the timing:** before Montserrat, none of this should exist. He shouldn't ask, Quinn shouldn't
offer, she shouldn't have anything to say about roots.

**The honest question:** he's a joke character in the original game — a man who mumbles until you're
drunk enough to understand him. I've tried to give him one sober moment without taking the joke away
from him. Tell me if that lands or if it's mawkish.
